title.ja: SSR と BFF: Nuxt をリージョンの Lambda で動かす
title.en: SSR and a BFF: Nuxt on Regional Lambda

sources.title: nuxt 4.6.1 (npm registry metadata and tarball)
supports: 4.6.1 was the `latest` dist-tag on 2026-10-11
Its server builder @nuxt/nitro-server 4.6.1 depends on nitropack ^2.13.4 (Nitro 2, not the nitro 3 beta)
`nuxt build` with the aws-lambda preset writes .output/server (handler and traced node_modules), .output/public/_nuxt, and .output/nitro.json
sources.note: The last item was observed by building examples/09-ssr. That Nuxt renders a page into one string before the handler writes it is an observation of the built handler (one write per page), not a documented guarantee.

sources.title: nitropack 2.13.4 (npm tarball: dist/presets/aws-lambda)
supports: The preset is named `aws-lambda`; its only option is `awsLambda.streaming` (boolean, default false)
With streaming false the entry exports `handler(event, context)` returning { statusCode, headers, cookies, body, isBase64Encoded }
With streaming true the entry is `awslambda.streamifyResponse(...)`, writes metadata through `awslambda.HttpResponseStream.from`, and adds `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`
Both entries rebuild the Cookie header from the event's `cookies` array and decode a base64 request body as UTF-8 text
.output/nitro.json records the preset and `config.awsLambda.streaming`
sources.note: Read from the installed package, dist/presets/aws-lambda/preset.mjs, types.d.ts, and runtime/aws-lambda{,-streaming}.mjs. The Nitro documentation site was not used as the basis.

sources.title: @vizejs/nuxt 0.443.0 (npm tarball and local build)
supports: `@vizejs/nuxt` is a Nuxt module with the config key `vize`; its peer range for nuxt is ^2.16.0 || ^3.0.0 || ^4.0.0
With the module listed in `modules`, Nuxt 4.6.1 `nuxt dev` and `nuxt build` compiled the .vue files of examples/09-ssr
`vize check` and `vize lint` ran on the Nuxt app directory with explicit imports from `nuxt/app`
sources.note: The package depends on @nuxt/kit 3.11.2, whose c12 reports an unmet peer (magicast ^0.3.4, found 0.5.5) at install. The build and dev server worked regardless. Auto-imported composables were not used, so type checking them through Vize is unverified. `vize check` reported no error for the globally registered NuxtLink and NuxtPage components; whether it type-checks their props was not examined.

sources.title: Restrict access to an AWS Lambda function URL origin
supports: To use OAC the function URL's AuthType must be AWS_IAM
CloudFront needs lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl and lambda:InvokeFunction, granted to cloudfront.amazonaws.com with the distribution as source ARN
For PUT or POST, the viewer must send the SHA256 of the body in x-amz-content-sha256; Lambda does not support unsigned payloads
With signing behavior `always`, CloudFront signs every origin request; `no-override` passes a viewer Authorization header through instead

sources.title: Control access to Lambda function URLs
supports: AuthType AWS_IAM authenticates and authorizes requests with IAM; NONE performs no authentication
Starting in October 2025, new function URLs require both lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl and lambda:InvokeFunction
Without those permissions in the resource-based policy, callers get 403 Forbidden

sources.title: Invoking Lambda function URLs
supports: Function URL events and responses follow API Gateway payload format version 2.0
Request cookies arrive in a `cookies` array; response cookies are returned in a `cookies` array

sources.title: Invoking a response streaming enabled function using Lambda function URLs
supports: InvokeMode BUFFERED is the default, uses the Invoke API, and has a 6 MB maximum payload
InvokeMode RESPONSE_STREAM uses InvokeWithResponseStream and has a 200 MB maximum response payload
sources.note: The page does not describe what a client receives when the invoke mode and the handler type disagree.

sources.title: Select a method to invoke your Lambda function using an HTTP request
supports: Function URLs have no charge beyond Lambda's own; authentication is IAM or none
API Gateway adds authorizers, throttling, request validation, custom domain names, and WAF integration
A function URL answers HTTP 429 once the function's concurrency limit is reached

sources.title: Response streaming for Lambda functions
supports: Streaming is available through function URLs, InvokeWithResponseStream, and the API Gateway proxy integration
Streamed responses can be up to 200 MB; buffered ones up to 6 MB
The first 6 MB is uncapped; the rest is limited to 2 MBps
Managed Node.js runtimes support streaming
A streamed response is not stopped when the client disconnects; the full duration is billed
Function URLs do not support response streaming inside a VPC

sources.title: Manage how long content stays in the cache (expiration)
supports: With minimum TTL 0, CloudFront respects Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, and private from the origin
With minimum TTL above 0, CloudFront caches for the minimum TTL even when those directives are present
With both max-age and s-maxage, CloudFront uses the lesser of s-maxage and the maximum TTL; browsers use max-age
Without Cache-Control, CloudFront caches for the default TTL
CloudFront supports stale-while-revalidate and stale-if-error, bounded by the maximum TTL

sources.title: Understand cache policies
supports: Values in the cache key are automatically included in origin requests
Cookies set to None are not in the cache key and not automatically sent to the origin
Minimum, maximum, and default TTL all 0 disables caching

sources.title: Cache content based on cookies
supports: By default CloudFront ignores cookies and removes them before forwarding a request to the origin
When cookies are forwarded, CloudFront caches Set-Cookie with the object and sends it on every cache hit
With cookies not forwarded, CloudFront removes Set-Cookie from responses before returning them
sources.note: The page is written in terms of the legacy forwarding settings. Whether Set-Cookie is removed under a cache policy with cookies set to None was not confirmed, which is why the stack also removes it with a response headers policy.

sources.title: Understand response headers policies
supports: Removed headers are removed from every response sent to viewers, whether served from the cache or from the origin
Set-Cookie is not in the list of headers that cannot be removed

sources.title: Serve compressed files
supports: CloudFront compresses only when the origin response has a Content-Length header, between 1,000 and 10,000,000 bytes
A response with Content-Encoding is passed through uncompressed-by-CloudFront
Compression needs Gzip or Brotli enabled in the cache policy

sources.title: How CloudFront processes HTTP 4xx and 5xx status codes from your origin
supports: CloudFront caches 404, 414, and 5xx responses for the error caching minimum TTL, 10 seconds by default
With the CachingDisabled managed policy, those status codes are not cached
CloudFront caches responses to GET and HEAD, optionally OPTIONS, and no other method
sources.note: How a `no-store` on a 404 interacts with the 10-second error caching minimum TTL is not stated plainly on the page.

sources.title: Origin settings
supports: The default origin response timeout is 30 seconds

sources.title: Working with Lambda environment variables
supports: AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME is a defined runtime environment variable holding the function's name

sources.title: MDN: Set-Cookie header
supports: HttpOnly forbids JavaScript from accessing the cookie
SameSite=Lax sends the cookie on same-site requests and on a limited set of cross-site navigations
A __Host- cookie must be Secure, set from HTTPS, have no Domain, and have Path=/

sources.title: Cloudflare Workers: Nuxt
supports: `wrangler deploy` detects Nuxt and generates a configuration with main .output/server/index.mjs, assets directory .output/public, and the nodejs_compat flag
Nuxt applications reach Cloudflare products through bindings, in local development and in production
sources.note: How Workers static assets are cached and billed was not read for this chapter.

sources.title: AWS Lambda pricing
supports: Free tier: 1,000,000 requests and 400,000 GB-seconds per month
Response streaming: first 6 MB per request free, then per GB
Response streaming is USD 0.008 per GB streamed, with 100 GB per month in the free tier
sources.note: The page does not say whether the free tier expires. It lists no separate charge for function URLs.

sources.title: aws-cdk-lib 2.273.0 (installed package and synthesized template)
supports: `FunctionUrlOrigin.withOriginAccessControl` synthesizes an OAC of origin type lambda and two AWS::Lambda::Permission resources: lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl, and lambda:InvokeFunction with InvokedViaFunctionUrl true, both limited to the distribution's ARN
`ResponseHeadersPolicy` accepts `removeHeaders`
`CachePolicy.CACHING_DISABLED` is 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad and `OriginRequestPolicy.ALL_VIEWER_EXCEPT_HOST_HEADER` is b689b0a8-53d0-40ab-baf2-68738e2966ac
sources.note: Read from the type definitions and from cdk.out/AihSsr.template.json produced by `vp run ssr:infra:synth`.

definition.ja: リクエストごとにサーバーで HTML を組み立てて返すこと。ブラウザは届いた HTML をまず表示し、そのあと JavaScript が引き継ぐ。
definition.en: Building the HTML on a server for each request. The browser shows that HTML first, and JavaScript takes over afterwards.

definition.ja: Lambda の関数 1 つに付く専用の HTTPS endpoint。API Gateway を挟まずに関数を HTTP で呼べる。
definition.en: A dedicated HTTPS endpoint attached to one Lambda function, which lets HTTP reach the function without API Gateway.

definition.ja: 1 つの応答を保存して、複数の利用者に返す cache。CDN がその例。ブラウザの中の cache は 1 人のものなので private cache と呼ぶ。
definition.en: A cache that stores one response and returns it to many users, such as a CDN. The cache inside a browser belongs to one person and is called a private cache.

definition.ja: CloudFront が「同じリクエスト」とみなす基準。path に加えて、cache policy で選んだ query string、header、cookie からできる。
definition.en: What CloudFront treats as the same request: the path plus whichever query strings, headers, and cookies the cache policy selects.

definition.ja: cache key に入れる値と、TTL の下限・既定・上限をまとめた CloudFront の設定。
definition.en: A CloudFront setting that holds what goes into the cache key and the minimum, default, and maximum TTL.

definition.ja: ある画面のためだけに置くサーバー。ブラウザの代わりに token を持ち、裏の API を呼ぶ。
definition.en: A server that exists for one front end. It holds tokens on the browser's behalf and calls the APIs behind it.

definition.ja: 応答を全部作り終える前に、できた分から送り始めること。
definition.en: Sending a response piece by piece as it is produced, before all of it exists.

tiers.description: $0.008 per GiB for Lambda-Streaming-Response-Processed-Bytes-ARM in Asia Pacific (Tokyo)

allowances.note: GB streamed beyond the first 6 MB of each request. From the pricing page and the Global-Lambda-Streaming-Response-Processed-Bytes USD 0 tier (0 to 100).

title.ja: SSR: デプロイ済みで誰も来ない月
title.en: SSR: deployed, but nobody visits for a month

ja: リクエストゼロ、publish ゼロ
bucket に 5 MB の静的 asset
log は 1 週間で失効し、保存量ゼロ
en: 5 MB of static assets in the bucket
Logs expire after a week; nothing is stored

items.basis: 5 MB stored for the month, in GB-month

title.ja: SSR: 月 10 万ページビュー

ja: 1 ページビューあたり CloudFront へ平均 4 リクエスト（HTML か API の JSON が 1、asset が平均 3）、合計 100 KB と仮定
すべて日本の edge から配信、HTTPS
HTML と API の 10 万リクエストのうち、半分が CloudFront の cache で返り、残り 5 万が Lambda に届くと仮定
Lambda は平均 200 ms、512 MB、arm64、buffered。200 ms は仮定で、計測値ではない
1 回の呼び出しあたり log 0.3 KB（Lambda が書く START/END/REPORT 行のみ）。保持 7 日で、月平均の保存量を取込み量の 7/30 と仮定
asset の 30 万リクエストのうち 1/10 が S3 に届くと仮定
publish は月 10 回、各 20 object を PUT。bucket に 5 MB
Lambda から CloudFront へのデータ転送、標準ログ、WAF、独自ドメインは含めていない（未算入）
en: Each page view is assumed to be 4 requests to CloudFront on average (1 for HTML or API JSON, 3 for assets) and 100 KB in total
Served entirely from Japan edge locations over HTTPS
Of the 100,000 HTML and API requests, half are assumed answered from CloudFront's cache and 50,000 reach Lambda
Lambda averages 200 ms at 512 MB, arm64, buffered. The 200 ms is an assumption, not a measurement
0.3 KB of logs per invocation (only Lambda's START/END/REPORT lines). 7-day retention; average stored volume assumed to be 7/30 of the monthly ingest
One tenth of the 300,000 asset requests are assumed to reach S3
10 publishes a month, 20 object PUTs each. 5 MB in the bucket
Data transfer from Lambda to CloudFront, standard logging, WAF, and a custom domain are not included

items.basis: 100,000 page views x 100 KB, in GB
half of 100,000 HTML and API requests
50,000 x 0.2 s x 0.5 GB, in GB-seconds
one tenth of 300,000 asset requests reach S3 as GET

note.ja: cache の判定、共有 cache 越しの漏れの再現、session、publish の計画、smoke の判定、CDK の assertion
note.en: The cache decision, the leak replayed through a shared cache, sessions, the publish plan, the smoke verdicts, and the CDK assertions

note.ja: tsc で core、server、infra、scripts、test。Vize で app の .vue。わざと入れた型エラーで vize check が失敗することも確認
note.en: tsc over core, server, infra, scripts, and test; Vize over the .vue files in app. A type error introduced on purpose made vize check fail

note.ja: Nuxt 4.6.1 と nitropack 2.13.4 の buffered な Lambda handler を function URL の形の event で呼び、ヘッダー、サインイン、共有 cache 越しの再現を確認。/feed は 1 回、HTML は 1 回で書かれた。Lambda では実行していない
note.en: Called the buffered Lambda handler built by Nuxt 4.6.1 and nitropack 2.13.4 with function URL shaped events and checked headers, sign-in, and the replay through a shared cache. /feed and the HTML were each written in one write. Not run on Lambda

note.ja: awslambda を記録用の偽物に差し替えて streaming の handler を呼んだ。/feed は 3 回（約 300 ms おき）、HTML は 1 回で書かれた。Lambda の runtime、function URL、CloudFront は通していない
note.en: Called the streaming handler with the awslambda global replaced by a recording fake. /feed was written in three writes about 300 ms apart, the HTML in one. The Lambda runtime, a function URL, and CloudFront were not involved

note.ja: cdkd で synth。template に function URL（AWS_IAM）、OAC、2 つの Lambda::Permission、cache policy、response headers policy があることを確認
note.en: Synthesized with cdkd. The template has the function URL (AWS_IAM), the OAC, two Lambda::Permission resources, the cache policy, and the response headers policy

note.ja: AIH_SSR_SIGN_IN=dev で起動し、公開ページ、404、/me、サインイン、サインアウト、よそからの POST の 403、/feed が 3 つに分かれて届くことを確認。ブラウザでの操作はしていない
note.en: Started with AIH_SSR_SIGN_IN=dev and checked public pages, the 404, /me, sign-in, sign-out, the 403 for a cross-site POST, and /feed arriving in three chunks. Not exercised in a browser

records.command: vp run ssr:infra:diff / deploy / drift / destroy, ssr:assets:plan, ssr:assets:publish, ssr:smoke, ssr:unpublish

note.ja: distribution、Lambda の関数と function URL、bucket を作る
note.en: Creates a distribution, a Lambda function with a function URL, and a bucket

summary.ja: 09章の構成を AWS で一度も動かしていない。Nitro の handler が Node.js 24 の runtime と function URL で動くこと、OAC の署名を function URL が受け入れ直接のリクエストを断ること、cache policy と response headers policy が意図どおり働くこと、smoke が見る x-cache と age ヘッダーの実際の値、許可していない method への応答が未確認。
summary.en: The chapter 09 setup has never run in AWS. Unconfirmed: that Nitro's handler runs on the Node.js 24 runtime behind a function URL, that the function URL accepts OAC-signed requests and refuses direct ones, that the cache policy and the response headers policy behave as intended, the real values of the x-cache and age headers the smoke test reads, and the response to a method that is not allowed.

resume.ja: vp run build:ssr、ssr:infra:deploy、ssr:assets:publish、ssr:smoke の順に実行する。smoke が落ちたら、判定（examples/09-ssr/scripts/smoke-spec.ts）と実際のヘッダーのどちらが違うのかを記録してから直す。終わったら ssr:unpublish --yes と ssr:infra:destroy。
resume.en: Run vp run build:ssr, ssr:infra:deploy, ssr:assets:publish, and ssr:smoke in that order. If the smoke test fails, record whether the verdict (examples/09-ssr/scripts/smoke-spec.ts) or the real headers differ before changing anything. Finish with ssr:unpublish --yes and ssr:infra:destroy.

summary.ja: response streaming が、Lambda、function URL（RESPONSE_STREAM）、CloudFront、ブラウザまで通して少しずつ届くかは未確認。stream した応答を CloudFront が圧縮しないこと、handler の形と InvokeMode が食い違ったときの応答も未確認。手元で確かめたのは Nitro の handler が書き込む回数と間隔だけ。
summary.en: Whether a streamed response arrives piece by piece across Lambda, the function URL (RESPONSE_STREAM), CloudFront, and a browser is unconfirmed. So are CloudFront not compressing a streamed response and what is returned when the handler's shape and InvokeMode disagree. Only the number and timing of the Nitro handler's writes were checked locally.

resume.ja: vp run ssr:check:output:stream、ssr:assets:publish、ssr:infra:deploy のあと、curl -sN で /feed を、curl -s -o /dev/null -D - --compressed で / を取得し、行が届く間隔と content-encoding を記録する。function URL を直接ではなく distribution 経由で見ること。
resume.en: After vp run ssr:check:output:stream, ssr:assets:publish, and ssr:infra:deploy, fetch /feed with curl -sN and / with curl -s -o /dev/null -D - --compressed, and record the spacing of the lines and the content-encoding. Go through the distribution, not the function URL directly.

summary.ja: cdkd 0.296.28 は AWS::CloudFront::CachePolicy と AWS::CloudFront::ResponseHeadersPolicy に専用の実装を持たず、Cloud Control API 経由で扱う。作成、更新、drift の読み戻し、削除が実際に動くかは未確認。minTtl と defaultTtl が 0、maxTtl が 60 の cache policy で圧縮の設定を有効にできるかも未確認。
summary.en: cdkd 0.296.28 has no dedicated implementation for AWS::CloudFront::CachePolicy or AWS::CloudFront::ResponseHeadersPolicy and handles them through Cloud Control API. Whether create, update, drift read-back, and delete work in practice is unconfirmed, as is whether a cache policy with minTtl and defaultTtl of 0 and maxTtl of 60 accepts the compression settings.

resume.ja: vp run ssr:infra:deploy と ssr:infra:drift を実行する。失敗する場合は内容を記録し、著者に判断を仰ぐ（別のツールへは置き換えない）。
resume.en: Run vp run ssr:infra:deploy and ssr:infra:drift. If they fail, record how and ask the author for a decision; do not substitute another tool.

summary.ja: 09章の BFF（サインイン、session、token の保持）は手元でしか動かない。session がプロセスのメモリにあり、サインインが POST で、function URL と OAC の組み合わせがブラウザの form からの POST をそのままでは通さないため。デプロイした環境で「cookie を持つ人にその人のページが返る」ことは確かめていない。
summary.en: Chapter 09's BFF (sign-in, sessions, holding the token) works only locally: sessions sit in process memory, sign-in is a POST, and a function URL with OAC does not pass a browser form POST as it is. That a deployed environment returns each cookie holder their own page was not checked.

resume.ja: 著者が方針を決める（session を DynamoDB に置き、POST の入口を API Gateway にする、など）。決まったら examples/09-ssr に実装し、ssr:smoke に本物の session での検査を足す。
resume.en: The author decides the approach (for example, sessions in DynamoDB and API Gateway as the POST entry point). Once decided, implement it in examples/09-ssr and add a check with a real session to ssr:smoke.
